6251.title: Reconnect leaves terminal interaction waits unresolved
6251.rootCauseOneLine: Session reopening never rechecks surviving daemon provider waits after the server interrupts their interaction.

prReviews.topFinding: Uses registration replay to close the observed lifecycle gap; its branch was not executed.

6251.proposedFix: Reconcile surviving waits through the existing registration endpoint on session opening, preserving open waits and ignoring stale responses.
6251.caveats: Deterministic server and daemon boundary reproduction; no live Claude session or historical multi-hour incident replay. Two unrelated broader-suite failures also reproduce on unchanged production code. Raw artifacts remain local under publication policy.
